findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Untrusted markdown to HTML without escaping
 * @description Detects uses of markdown_it to render untrusted markdown directly to HTML, which can lead to XSS if consumers assume the output is safe.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/markdown-it-untrusted-html
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("markdown_it").getMember("MarkdownIt").getACall()
select call, "Construction of MarkdownIt parser; ensure HTML rendering is configured safely when used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Library exposes MarkdownIt construction that may be used insecurely with untrusted markdown, leading to XSS in consumers.

message.text: Construction of MarkdownIt parser; ensure HTML rendering is configured safely when used with untrusted input.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess and shell command usage in markdown-it-py
 * @description Flags any use of subprocess or os.system in the package for manual review.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/markdown-it-subprocess-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of system shell or subprocess; ensure no untrusted input is passed without proper sanitization."
findings.hypothesis: Package may invoke shell commands (e.g., in scripts/ or CLI) that could be influenced by user input

message.text: Use of system shell or subprocess; ensure no untrusted input is passed without proper sanitization.
Use of system shell or subprocess; ensure no untrusted input is passed without proper sanitization.
